text: Figure 4.9: Specifying Arbitrary LET Intervals with Overlap T able 4.3 below summarizes the duration of the LET intervals and the offsets between the release point of the LET interval 1 and the release points of the LET intervals 2 through 4 as shown in Figure 4.9. LET Interval Length Offset 1 8ms No offset 2 6ms 13ms 3 12ms 4ms 4 14ms 3ms Table 4.3: Specifying Arbitrary LET Intervals with Overlap The periodic event triggering constraint PeriodicEventTriggering is used to specify that the period of the sequence is 19ms. The listing C.9 shows an ARXML fragment which specifies three offset timing con- straints between the release point of LET interval 1 and the three release points of the LET interval 2 through LET interval 4. The values of the offsets are selected such that LET interval 3 and LET interval 4 are overlapping the LET interval 1 and LET interval 2. The offset between the release points of LET interval 1 and LET interval 2 is 13ms; the offset between the release point of LET interval 1 and LET interval 3 is 4ms; and the offset between the release point of LET interval 1 and LET interval 4 is 3ms.
